summary: Prologis, L.P. filed an 8-K reporting the pricing of C$850M in 4.250% Notes due 2034 under an underwriting agreement with Scotia Capital Inc. and TD Securities Inc. The filing discloses a direct financial obligation and other events, but no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change is present. This is a standard debt offering in the ordinary course of financing, not a special situation. The notes will be used for general corporate purposes; no premium, board recommendation, or risk-arb angle applies.
